name: Make
description: Make is a visual automation platform where users build multi-step workflows, called scenarios, connecting apps, data sources, and AI models by configuring modules on a canvas.
best_for: Positioned for teams across many departments — marketing, sales, operations, finance, IT, HR — in organizations ranging from smaller teams to large enterprises.
features: Option to build via code or natural-language prompt
Centralized management of automations across an organization

alternatives.description: A workflow automation platform for technical users, combining a visual canvas with custom code and self-hosting options.
